items.text: तस्मान्नायं दृष्टान्तो न प्रत्यक्षं न चानुमानं किंचिदुच्यत इति

items.text: तदिदं दृष्टान्तस्य साध्यसमत्वमभिधीयत इति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अथवा नाकृताभ्यागमप्रसङ्गात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अणुश्यामतादृष्टान्तेनाकर्मनिमित्तां शरीरोत्पत्तिं समादधानस्याकृताभ्यागमप्रसङ्गः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अकृते सुखदुःखहेतौ कर्मणि पुरुषस्य सुखं दुःखमभ्यागच्छतीति प्रसज्येत
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ओमिति ब्रुवतः प्रत्यक्षानुमानागमविरोधः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रत्यक्षविरोधस्तावत् भिन्नमिदं सुखदुःखं प्रत्यात्मवेदनीयत्वात्प्रत्यक्षं सर्वशरीरिणाम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: को भेदः तीव्रं मन्दं चिरमाशु नानाप्रकारमेकप्रकारमित्येवमादिर्विशेषः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न चास्ति प्रत्यात्मनियतः सुखदुःखहेतुविशेषो न चासति हेतुविशेषे फलविशेषो दृश्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कर्मनिमित्ते तु सुखदुःखयोगे कर्मणां तीव्रमन्दतोपपत्तेः कर्मसञ्चयानां चोत्कर्षापकर्षभावात् नानाविधैकविधभावाच्च कर्मणां सुखदुःखभेदोपपत्तिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सो ऽयं हेतुभेदाभावाद्दृष्टः सुखदुःखभेदो न स्यादिति प्रत्यक्षविरोधः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तथानुमानविरोधः दृष्टं हि पुरुषगुणव्यवस्थानात्सुखदुःखव्यवस्थानम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यः खलु चेतनावान् साधननिर्वर्तनीयं सुखं बुद्ध्वा तदीप्सन् साधनावाप्तये प्रयतते स सुखेन युज्यते न विपरीतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यश्च साधननिर्वर्तनीयं दुःखं बुद्ध्वा तज्जिहासुः साधनपरिवर्जनाय यतते स च दुःखेन त्यज्यते न विपरीतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अस्ति चेदं यत्नमन्तरेण चेतनानां सुखदुःखव्यवस्थानं तेनापि चेतनगुणान्तरव्यवस्थाकृतेन भवितव्यमित्यनुमानम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तदेतदकर्मनिमित्ते सुखदुःखयोगे विरुध्यत इति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तच्च गुणान्तरमसंवेद्यत्वाददृष्टं विपाककालानियमाच्चाव्यवस्थितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: बुद्ध्यादयस्तु संवेद्याश्चापवर्गिणश्चेति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अथागमविरोधः बहु खल्विदमार्षमृषीणामुपदेशजातमनुष्ठानपरिवर्जनाश्रयमुपदेशफलं च शरीरिणां वर्णाश्रमविभागेणानुष्ठानलक्षणा प्रवृत्तिः परिवर्जनलक्षणा निवृत्तिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तच्चोभयमेतस्यां दृष्टौ नास्ति कर्म सुचरितं दुश्चरितं वा कर्मनिमित्तः पुरुषाणां सुखदुःखयोगः इति विरुध्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सेयं पापिष्ठानां मिथ्यादृष्टिः अकर्मनिमित्ता शरीरसृष्टिरकर्मनिमित्तः सुखदुःखयोग इति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: केन प्रकारेण किंधर्मकात्कारणाद्व्यक्तं शरीराद्युत्पद्यत इति व्यक्ताद्भूतसमाख्यातात्पृथिव्यादितः परमसूक्ष्मान्नित्याद्व्यक्तं शरीरेन्द्रियविषयोपकरणाधारं प्रज्ञातं द्रव्यमुत्पद्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: व्यक्तं च खल्विन्द्रियग्राह्यं तत्सामान्यात्कारणमपि व्यक्तम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: किं सामान्यं रूपादिगुणयोगः रूपादिगुणयुक्तेभ्यः पृथिव्यादिभ्यो नित्येभ्यो रूपादिगुणयुक्तं शरीराद्युत्पद्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रत्यक्षप्रामाण्याद्दृष्टो हि रूपादिगुणयुक्तेभ्यो मृत्प्रभृतिभ्यस्तथाभूतस्य द्रव्यस्योत्पादः तेन चादृष्टस्यानुमानमिति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: रूपादीनामन्वयदर्शनात्प्रकृतिविकारयोः पृथिव्यादीनां नित्यानामतीन्द्रियाणां कारणभावो ऽनुमीयत इति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
